secrets.name: The Room Under the Dune
secrets.text: A reading room like the one above, filled to the shoulders with sand that came in grain by grain. One lamp still works. Somebody dug a path to the desk and kept on reading.

meta.label: The Desert Room
meta.blurb: Sand. A reading room full of it, up to the table tops, and still coming in at the windows. The lamps are on. Nobody has asked for the room to be swept.
